Change one setting. Settings that change what production apps get ask first; --yes skips that. The
settings and their values:

  paid-access-sharing.production shared|transfer|disabled
  paid-access-sharing.sandbox shared|transfer|disabled
  store-sandbox-unlocks-production on|off
  ads-key-conversion signup|trial|payer
  ads-attribution-window-days 1-90
  sandbox-purchasing on|off

Usage:
  voidhash settings set [key] [value] [flags]

Arguments:
  key    The setting: paid-access-sharing.production, paid-access-sharing.sandbox,
         store-sandbox-unlocks-production, ads-key-conversion, ads-attribution-window-days,
         sandbox-purchasing
  value  Its new value

Flags:
  -h, --help               Show help for this command
      --json               Print the API objects as JSON, for scripts
      --project <project>  Project to act on: its id, slug, organization/slug or name (default: this
                           directory's project, then your default project)
  -y, --yes                Make the change without asking for confirmation

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash settings set ads-key-conversion trial
  voidhash settings set paid-access-sharing.production shared --yes
